issue.title: Re-run the task-theme ledger replay two weeks after seeding and retune note defaults
issue.description:
Proposed by bob-cli-dm.9 note #1 (epic bob-cli-dm, phase seed-defaults), and required by the
seed-defaults section of plan:202610/task_theme_suggestions.md. The bob-cli-dm land agent
filed it.

On 2026-10-28, bob-cli-dm.9 seeded the first Pomodoro theme note defaults in ~/bob (vault
commit 25e44d44):
- dev.md `theme: BUILD`
- love.md `theme: CHORE`
- job.md `theme: WRITE`
- sase_blog.md `theme: WRITE`
- job_2026.md `theme: CHORE`
- dev_plex_hack_patch.md `theme: CHORE`

bob-cli-e2.3 later added `theme: PLAN` to gtd_daily.md, which replaced the retired
"daily review" suggestion step. These defaults drive the PT13 suggestion rule
(docs/pomodoro-themes.md) in capture completion, `bob ref today`, the Obsidian
Link-to-today picker, the Task Card, and Bob Mac Capture.

The research report
research:202610/task_theme_suggestions_and_overrides/task_theme_suggestions_and_overrides.md
(read it with `sase artifact read`) predicted the following from a ledger replay:
- the suggestion matches the chosen theme on about 78–80 % of links;
- about 88 % for re-linked tasks;
- at most about one linked task in four should ever carry a `[theme:: X]` field.

Around 2026-11-12 (two weeks after seeding), do the following:
1. Re-run that ledger replay over the post-seeding daily notes. Measure the match rate per
   declaring note, and count the `[theme::]` fields that deliberate choices wrote. Use
   `bob query`, or a scan for `[theme::` / `(theme::` on task lines.
2. Retune the note defaults where a note's links mostly chose another theme. Edit only
   `theme:` frontmatter, then confirm with `bob themes suggest`. Never invent `[theme::]`
   fields or fake history.
3. Decide whether a read-only `theme_default_drift` hint is worth adding to
   `bob themes list` (for example, a default whose recent links disagree with it most of
   the time). If so, follow PT3's +5 ms warm p95 budget and sase/memory/cli_rules.md.

task_type_fields.proposal: Around 2026-11-12, replay the post-seeding Pomodoro ledger against the PT13 suggestion rule, retune the seeded theme: note defaults, and consider a read-only theme_default_drift hint in bob themes list.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: bob-cli-dm shipped the suggestion rule and seeded the defaults; meaningful retuning needs two weeks of real links that did not exist when the epic landed.

issue.creation_reason: The bob-cli-dm plan requires a measured retune of the first theme: note defaults once two weeks of post-seeding links exist; bob-cli-dm.9 proposed it and the epic land agent files it.
